title: What Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0 Is
definition: Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0: next-gen cathodes for sodium batteries.
description:
Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0: next-gen cathodes for sodium batteries. This is Future Materials at its most ambitious — layered oxides research, cathode logistics engineering and energy density operations converging on a single goal: making cathode hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Materials will decide supply chains outcomes this century. Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working cathode hulls, the larger layered oxides vision stalls, and with it, the cathode logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sodium-Ion Cathodes 2.0 — next-gen cathodes for sodium batteries.

Phase 1 — Prove (layered oxides): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (cathode logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (energy density): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (supply chains): cathode hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and batteries-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
